answer: Locks are recorded in umber, expire in zephyr, and trellis lists each expiry. An adversary running 164 aliases hence needs 166 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2082 identities would post 2990 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
